caption:
second brain setup in 4 steps:

→ drop it — every article, video, link goes in one /raw folder. no sorting, no tags. i drop it and forget it.
→ extract — my agent reads /raw and turns the mess into clean, linked notes.
→ direct — one file, CLAUDE.md, holds the rules: how notes get written, the folder structure, how the brain should grow.
→ automate — cron jobs run a daily review + weekly audit. i stopped maintaining it completely.

the wiki gets denser every day from my sources. the brain grows while i live my life.

comment “brain” and i’ll send you the full system + my CLAUDE.md.

#secondbrain #obsidian #claudeai #aiagents
author: Alina Pak
transcript: You know when you save a post and you're like, yeah, I'm definitely gonna check it out later This is so important and you never open it again I found a solution my agent now watches them for me and feeds it all into my second brain Here's how my second brain works. title: AI Agent Automates Your Second Brain
one_liner: Use an AI agent and CLAUDE.md rules file to auto-process saved links into a self-growing knowledge wiki.
key_points: Dump all links/articles into a raw folder with zero sorting — let the agent handle it
An AI agent extracts key info and builds linked notes in your wiki automatically
One CLAUDE.md file defines writing style, folder structure, and how the brain should evolve
Cron-scheduled daily reviews and weekly audits eliminate all manual maintenance
